title: atoll mergerfs-config --json
description: The mergerfs configuration of the merged view, for phase 1 and break glass (specs.md §21.1, §25).

branches.description: The data disks, in configuration order.

options.description: Each option as key=value, in the order of specs.md §21.1.

largest_file_bytes.description: The size of the largest file the catalog knows, or null when it knows none.

fstab.description: The line the command prints without --json, with no line feed: branches, mount point, type, options, 0 and 0, with what fstab(5) needs escaped.

omv.description: With --omv only: the same pool as the openmediavault mergerfs plugin's form takes it, for the plugin 8.0.5 and mergerfs 2.42 or later (specs.md §21.1, docs/research/omv-mergerfs.md).

rpc.description: The parameters of the plugin's RPC, omv-rpc -u admin MergerFS set, as its form sends them. The RPC also needs the pool's uuid: fa4b1c66-ef79-11e5-87a0-0002b3a176b4, openmediavault's for a new object, makes a new pool.

name.description: The pool's name: the last component of view.mount when it is /srv/mergerfs/<name>; otherwise that last component still, or pool_id when the form would refuse it.

paths.description: Each branch as <path>=<mode>, a line each, in the order of branches, with no line feed after the last; not escaped.

minfreespace.description: The pool's one minimum free space, a count of minfreespaceunit, which view.omv_min_free decides from the branches that take new files; null when none can be given: none of them has a minfreespace of its own, or with view.omv_min_free = "same" theirs differ.

minfreespaceunit.description: K, M or G, powers of 1024; null with minfreespace.

options.description: The options, as key=value joined by a comma, in the order of specs.md §21.1, but category.create, which createpolicy gives.

mount.description: Where the plugin mounts the pool: /srv/mergerfs/<name>.

warnings.description: In byte order; each is also said on standard error. minfreespace-differs: with view.omv_min_free = "same", the branches that take new files have different minfreespace, so the pool has none, and the command exits with 4. minfreespace-rounded: no count of K, M or G up to 99999 holds the pool's minfreespace exactly, so it is rounded up. mount-elsewhere: view.mount is not the mount point the plugin gives the pool.

mode.description: RW; NC for a disk draining, RO for a disk failed, which comes after the others (specs.md §21.1).

minfreespace_bytes.description: What placement.min_free keeps free on the disk, or null when the branch has none of its own: its capacity was never recorded and min_free holds no size.
